cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: a starship data archive — standing; an indoor surf-wave practice pool with turquoise water — she takes a cheerful break from balancing practice; a neighbourhood grocery or convenience store with bright aisles — standing close to a high shelf or line; a present-day museum gallery of Three Kingdoms relics — holds her keepsake in both hands in front of her; a bright glass-roofed intercity tram moving through a coastal city — she balances a small paper bag of freshly roasted chestnuts on her lap; a mountain lodge with a front counter and a fireplace — standing; a hydroponic garden dome aboard a starship — checks the photo on the back screen of a camera at chest height; a mirrored labyrinth of endless reflections and soft coloured light — holds a folding fan open near her chest; a Korean jjimjilbang hall with heated floors and sleeping mats — dries her hair with a towel; a starship galley and mess hall — holds a folded cleaning cloth at chest height; a cable car cabin over a misty valley — touches one ear cup of a pair of over-ear headphones hung around her neck; the open deck of a wooden sightseeing boat on the Yangtze — seated sideways on a stool or bench; an editorial photo studio with a seamless backdrop and dramatic lights — standing
